description: This source file defines a class `RedisRemindersProviderBuilder` that implements `IProviderBuilder<ISiloBuilder>` for configuring Redis-based reminder services within Orleans hosting. It contains methods to set up Redis connection options based on provided configuration, either via a service key with a connection multiplexer or a connection string, integrating with Orleans silo builders.

classes.name: RedisRemindersProviderBuilder
classes.description: A class that implements the `IProviderBuilder<ISiloBuilder>` interface to configure Redis reminder services in Orleans silo.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the Orleans silo builder to use Redis for reminders, setting up connection options based on configuration parameters.
